messages:
Clara Voss: Kickoff: Systems Integrator deep-dive webinar with ForgeWorks is set for Oct 12. Focus: on-prem appliance demo + marketplace integration. Need owners: hardware runbook, air-gapped demo kit, legal NDAs, and shipping labels.

Diego Morales: I'll own the hardware runbook. Two asks: ensure HSM/KMS notes for key import, and include a network-fallback plan (offline demo flow).

Hannah Lee: I'll handle NDAs and partner contract terms. Quick Q: do we require a signed AUP before we share any kit?

Clara Voss: Yes - AUP + basic SOW signed. Hold shipment until legal confirms.

Owen Park: For the air-gapped demo kit, propose: USB with runbook + canned responses, HDMI dongle, power cable, and a printed checklist. No model checkpoints. Label: "AIRGAP KIT - DO NOT CONNECT TO INTERNET".

Marta (logistics): Noted. Courier needs HS codes and a declared value. To minimize customs friction, declare as "Demo kit - documents & accessories" value $9.00 each. ETA windows: EU hub 10/06-10/08, NA by 10/07.

Diego Morales: Runbook snippet for offline fallback (add to docs):

```
# offline demo: use canned responses
python offline_demo.py --seed canned_responses.json --mode local
```

Hannah Lee: Legal requires a checklist before shipping to partner labs: signed NDA, SOW, AUP, and partner contact email/phone. I'll add a hold flag in the tracker until documents are in.

Clara Voss: Also need an ops contact at ForgeWorks for in-country acceptance tests. @Diego please request contact and voltage/plug type for local kits.

Diego Morales: Requested; ForgeWorks provided contact "Priyanka Shah" and said EU labs use Type-F plugs. Will update manifest.

Owen Park: For the live handoff during the webinar, plan: 1) demo intro (2m) 2) switch to local appliance (5m) 3) run short CLI test (3m) 4) Q&A. Need a 6-min pre-recorded fallback in case network/connectivity fails. I'll own the pre-record.

Marta (logistics): Shipping note: mark boxes with fragile and add label "WEBINAR: FORGEWORKS + REDWOOD - HOLD FOR ACCEPTANCE". Return policy: undelivered -> hold 30 days then return to Redwood HQ.

SI Partner Bot: Reminder: partner requested video usage rights for training. Please confirm license type.

Hannah Lee: Approve partner internal training use only, non-commercial, with attribution. I'll draft a short license addendum and share for review.

Clara Voss: Runbook includes short switch-to-hosted snippet for rollback, add to runbook and the USB run-media: 

```
# rollback to hosted endpoint
export REDWOOD_API_KEY=REDACTED
python demo_client.py --endpoint https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate --model redwood-onprem-lite
```

Diego Morales: We'll instrument health-checks that show green if appliance responds under 200ms local loopback. Add an audible ping in runbook so presenter hears when it's ready.

Owen Park: Pre-recorded fallback will be MP4 1080p, include captions and transcript in .srt. I'll upload by 10/05.

Marta (logistics): Courier: TransGlobal ref TG-3344. I'll post tracking here once labels are printed. Also need receiver names: EU -> "ForgeWorks EU - Events (attn: Priyanka Shah)"; NA -> "Redwood Events - Receiving".

Hannah Lee: One more legal ask: avoid disclosing internal benchmarking numbers without partner signoff. Flag any slide with numbers for legal review.

Clara Voss: Final owners: Diego (hardware runbook & acceptance tests), Owen (pre-record + demo script), Hannah (legal & license), Marta (shipping & labels). We'll reconvene 10/03 for a dry-run and final checklist. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
